title: Countries You Can Safely Invest In
key_insight: 按国家分组计算平均通话时长，与全局平均比较
approach: JOIN person/country/calls表，GROUP BY country，HAVING avg > global avg
code_python3: SELECT co.name AS country FROM Person p JOIN Country co ON LEFT(p.phone_number,3)=co.country_code JOIN Calls c ON p.id IN (c.caller_id, c.callee_id) GROUP BY co.name HAVING AVG(c.duration) > (SELECT AVG(duration) FROM Calls)

title: Can Make Arithmetic Progression From Sequence
key_insight: 排序后检查相邻差值是否相等
approach: 排序数组，遍历检查arr[i]-arr[i-1]是否恒定

title: Last Moment Before All Ants Fall Out of a Plank
key_insight: 两只蚂蚁相遇等价于穿过彼此，所以只需考虑每只蚂蚁到边界的距离
approach: 向左走的蚂蚁最大位置和向右走的蚂蚁(n-pos)最大值取max

title: Count Submatrices With All Ones
key_insight: 对每个位置计算以该位置为右下角的连续1的宽度，然后向上扩展统计矩形数
approach: 预处理每行连续1的宽度，对每个位置向上遍历取min宽度累加

title: Minimum Possible Integer After at Most K Adjacent Swaps on Digits
key_insight: 贪心选最小数字移到前面，用BIT维护实际位置偏移
approach: 从左到右每个位置，找k步内能移到当前位置的最小数字，用BIT计算实际移动距离

title: Find Root of N-Ary Tree
key_insight: 根节点是唯一不作为任何节点子节点出现的节点，用异或或求和差找出
approach: 所有节点值异或，再异或所有子节点值，剩余即为根

title: Reformat Date
key_insight: 解析日月年字符串并格式化为YYYY-MM-DD
approach: 分割字符串，映射月份，提取日期数字

title: Range Sum of Sorted Subarray Sums
key_insight: 生成所有子数组和并排序，取第left到right个元素求和
approach: 双重循环生成所有子数组和，排序后切片求和取模

title: Minimum Difference Between Largest and Smallest Value in Three Moves
key_insight: 排序后最多去掉3个元素(从两端)，枚举去掉左i右3-i个的情况
approach: 排序，枚举去掉左边0-3个和右边3-0个，取最小差值

title: Stone Game IV
key_insight: dp[i]表示剩余i个石头时当前玩家是否能赢
approach: dp[i]=True如果存在某个完全平方数j^2使得dp[i-j^2]=False

title: Customer Order Frequency
key_insight: 按客户分组，筛选6月和7月消费均>=100的客户
approach: JOIN orders和product表，按月份分组计算消费额，HAVING筛选
code_python3: SELECT c.customer_id, c.name FROM Customers c JOIN Orders o ON c.customer_id=o.customer_id JOIN Product p ON o.product_id=p.product_id GROUP BY c.customer_id HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m')='2020-06' THEN o.quantity*p.price ELSE 0 END)>=100 AND SUM(CASE WHEN DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date,'%Y-%m')='2020-07' THEN o.quantity*p.price ELSE 0 END)>=100

title: Number of Good Pairs
key_insight: 相同数字中任选2个即为good pair，用计数公式C(n,2)
approach: 统计每个数字出现次数，对每个次数c累加c*(c-1)/2

title: Number of Substrings With Only 1s
key_insight: 连续k个1贡献k*(k+1)/2个子串
approach: 遍历统计连续1的长度，每段贡献n*(n+1)/2

title: Path with Maximum Probability
key_insight: 用Dijkstra变体求最大概率路径，用最大堆
approach: 建图存概率权重，用最大堆Dijkstra从start到end

title: Best Position for a Service Centre
key_insight: 求几何中位数(Weiszfeld算法)，最小化到所有点的欧氏距离之和
approach: Weiszfeld迭代算法或scipy.optimize求解

title: Move Sub-Tree of N-Ary Tree
key_insight: 将子树q移动为p的子节点，需处理q是p祖先的特殊情况
approach: DFS找父节点，处理q是p祖先的情况后执行移动

title: Find Users With Valid E-Mails
key_insight: 用正则表达式匹配有效邮箱格式
approach: REGEXP匹配以字母开头，包含字母数字._-，以@leetcode.com结尾
code_python3: SELECT * FROM Users WHERE mail REGEXP '^[a-zA-Z][a-zA-Z0-9._-]*@leetcode\\.com$'

title: Water Bottles
key_insight: 喝完的空瓶可以换新瓶，循环直到空瓶不够换
approach: 模拟：喝掉所有瓶子，空瓶换新瓶，重复直到空瓶<numExchange

title: Number of Nodes in the Sub-Tree With the Same Label
key_insight: DFS后序遍历，统计子树中每个字母的出现次数
approach: DFS返回子树中26个字母的计数数组，当前节点答案为对应字母计数

title: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Substrings
key_insight: 找出所有有效子串(包含字符的所有出现)，然后贪心选最多不重叠的
approach: 计算每个字符的最小有效区间，验证有效性，按右端点贪心选择

title: Find a Value of a Mysterious Function Closest to Target
key_insight: AND运算只会让值变小或不变，且不同的AND结果数量是O(log max)级别
approach: 维护以当前位置结尾的所有可能AND值集合(最多log个)，逐步更新

title: Diameter of N-Ary Tree
key_insight: N叉树直径是经过某节点的最长路径，等于该节点最大两个子树深度之和
approach: DFS返回深度，维护经过每个节点的最长路径(最大两子树深度和)

title: Count Odd Numbers in an Interval Range
key_insight: 区间[low,high]中奇数个数可用公式直接计算

title: Number of Sub-arrays With Odd Sum
key_insight: 前缀和为奇数的个数和偶数的个数相乘即为奇数和子数组数
approach: 维护前缀和的奇偶计数，每个位置贡献=之前相反奇偶性的前缀和个数

title: Number of Good Ways to Split a String
key_insight: 统计每个分割点左右两边不同字符数是否相等
approach: 前缀统计左边distinct数，后缀统计右边distinct数，比较

title: Minimum Number of Increments on Subarrays to Form a Target Array
key_insight: 操作次数等于相邻元素递增差值之和(类似柱状图需要的水平线段数)
approach: 遍历数组，当target[i]>target[i-1]时需要额外target[i]-target[i-1]次操作

title: Patients With a Condition
key_insight: 用LIKE匹配conditions字段中以DIAB1开头的条件
approach: WHERE conditions LIKE 'DIAB1%' OR conditions LIKE '% DIAB1%'
code_python3: SELECT * FROM Patients WHERE conditions LIKE 'DIAB1%' OR conditions LIKE '% DIAB1%'

title: Shuffle String
key_insight: 按indices数组重新排列字符
approach: 创建结果数组，res[indices[i]] = s[i]

title: Minimum Suffix Flips
key_insight: 每次当前位与目标不同时需要翻转一次后缀
approach: 从左到右遍历，记录当前翻转状态，不匹配时翻转计数+1

title: Number of Good Leaf Nodes Pairs
key_insight: DFS返回每个节点到其子树叶子节点的距离列表，在LCA处统计配对
approach: 后序遍历，合并左右子树的叶子距离列表，统计距离和<=distance的对数

title: String Compression II
key_insight: dp[i][k]表示前i个字符删除k个后的最短编码长度
approach: 枚举保留的连续段，计算编码长度，状态转移取最小值

title: The Most Recent Three Orders
key_insight: 用ROW_NUMBER窗口函数按客户分组取最近3个订单
approach: ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date DESC)，筛选rn<=3
code_python3: SELECT name, customer_id, order_id, order_date FROM (SELECT c.name, o.customer_id, o.order_id, o.order_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY o.customer_id ORDER BY o.order_date DESC) rn FROM Orders o JOIN Customers c ON o.customer_id=c.customer_id) t WHERE rn<=3 ORDER BY name, customer_id, order_date DESC

title: Find the Index of the Large Integer
key_insight: 用ArrayReader.compareSub二分查找最大元素位置
approach: 二分区间，比较左右半部分大小，缩小搜索范围

title: Count Good Triplets
key_insight: 三重循环枚举所有三元组检查条件
approach: 枚举i<j<k，检查|arr[i]-arr[j]|<=a, |arr[j]-arr[k]|<=b, |arr[i]-arr[k]|<=c

title: Find the Winner of an Array Game
key_insight: 模拟比较过程，当某元素连续赢k次或已是最大值时返回
approach: 维护当前赢家和连胜次数，遍历一遍即可(最大值必定最终获胜)

title: Minimum Swaps to Arrange a Binary Grid
key_insight: 每行需要后缀0的数量满足条件，贪心找最近满足条件的行交换上来
approach: 计算每行后缀0数量，从上到下贪心找满足条件的最近行冒泡上来

title: Get the Maximum Score
key_insight: 两个有序数组在公共元素处可以切换路径，贪心选择每段最大和
approach: 双指针遍历两数组，在公共元素处取两段和的最大值，累加

title: Guess the Majority in a Hidden Array
key_insight: 通过query4比较相邻元素关系推断多数元素
approach: 用query4确定每个元素与arr[0]的关系，统计同组和异组数量

title: Kth Missing Positive Number
key_insight: 二分查找第k个缺失的正整数，arr[i]前缺失数=arr[i]-i-1
approach: 二分找到arr[mid]-mid-1 < k的最大位置，答案为k+left

title: Can Convert String in K Moves
key_insight: 每个位置需要的shift次数确定，相同shift需要间隔26步
approach: 统计每种shift(1-25)需要的次数，检查最大使用的move编号是否<=k

title: Minimum Insertions to Balance a Parentheses String
key_insight: 左括号匹配两个右括号，贪心处理不匹配情况
approach: 遍历字符串，维护需要的右括号数，遇到不匹配时插入

title: Find Longest Awesome Substring
key_insight: 回文排列最多一个字符出现奇数次，用bitmask记录奇偶状态
approach: 前缀异或状态，相同状态或只差一位的状态之间的子串可构成回文排列

title: Fix Product Name Format
key_insight: 清理产品名(trim+lower)和格式化日期，按组统计
approach: TRIM+LOWER处理product_name，DATE_FORMAT格式化sale_date，GROUP BY统计
code_python3: SELECT LOWER(TRIM(product_name)) AS product_name, DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') AS sale_date, COUNT(*) AS total FROM Sales GROUP BY LOWER(TRIM(product_name)), DATE_FORMAT(sale_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY product_name, sale_date

title: Make The String Great
key_insight: 相邻大小写相同字母需删除，用栈模拟
approach: 遍历字符，栈顶与当前字符互为大小写则弹出，否则入栈

title: Find Kth Bit in Nth Binary String
key_insight: 字符串结构为S(n)=S(n-1)+1+reverse(invert(S(n-1)))，递归定位
approach: 递归判断k在左半、中间还是右半，右半需要翻转取反

title: Maximum Number of Non-Overlapping Subarrays With Sum Equals Target
key_insight: 贪心选择结束位置最早的和为target的子数组
approach: 前缀和+哈希表记录最近出现位置，贪心选最短子数组

title: Minimum Cost to Cut a Stick
key_insight: 区间DP，dp[i][j]表示切割cuts[i]到cuts[j]之间木棍的最小代价
approach: 排序cuts加入0和n，dp[i][j]=min(dp[i][k]+dp[k][j])+cuts[j]-cuts[i]

title: The Most Similar Path in a Graph
key_insight: dp[i][j]表示路径第i步在节点j时与目标路径的最小编辑距离
approach: DP遍历路径长度和图节点，转移考虑相邻节点，记录路径

title: The Most Recent Orders for Each Product
key_insight: 用RANK窗口函数按产品分组取最近订单日期
approach: RANK() OVER(PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY order_date DESC)，筛选rk=1
code_python3: SELECT product_name, p.product_id, order_id, order_date FROM Products p JOIN Orders o ON p.product_id=o.product_id WHERE (o.product_id, o.order_date) IN (SELECT product_id, MAX(order_date) FROM Orders GROUP BY product_id) ORDER BY product_name, product_id, order_id

title: Three Consecutive Odds
key_insight: 检查是否存在连续三个奇数
approach: 遍历数组维护连续奇数计数，达到3返回True

title: Minimum Operations to Make Array Equal
key_insight: 数组为[1,3,5,...,2n-1]，目标为n，操作次数为n^2/4
approach: 每对(arr[i], arr[n-1-i])需要n-arr[i]次操作，求和得n*n//4

title: Magnetic Force Between Two Balls
key_insight: 二分最小磁力(距离)，贪心验证能否放置m个球
approach: 排序位置，二分答案，贪心检查以该最小距离能放多少球

title: Minimum Number of Days to Eat N Oranges
key_insight: BFS或记忆化搜索，每次可以吃1个、吃n/2个(n%2==0)或吃2n/3个(n%3==0)
approach: 记忆化递归：dp(n)=1+min(n%2+dp(n//2), n%3+dp(n//3))

title: Strings Differ by One Character
key_insight: 用Rolling Hash检查是否存在两个字符串恰好相差一个字符
approach: 对每个位置mask掉一个字符后的hash值，检查是否有重复

title: Bank Account Summary
key_insight: 计算每个用户的余额(初始+收入-支出)，筛选低于阈值的
approach: LEFT JOIN transactions表计算净收支，加上初始credit，与阈值比较
code_python3: SELECT u.user_id, u.user_name, u.credit + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.user_id=t.paid_to THEN t.amount WHEN u.user_id=t.paid_by THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) AS credit, CASE WHEN u.credit + IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN u.user_id=t.paid_to THEN t.amount WHEN u.user_id=t.paid_by THEN -t.amount ELSE 0 END),0) < 0 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS credit_limit_breached FROM Users u LEFT JOIN Transactions t ON u.user_id IN (t.paid_by, t.paid_to) GROUP BY u.user_id

title: Thousand Separator
key_insight: 每三位数字加一个点分隔符
approach: 转字符串从右往左每3位插入'.'

title: Minimum Number of Vertices to Reach All Nodes
key_insight: 入度为0的节点必须作为起点，且这些节点足以到达所有节点
approach: 统计所有节点入度，返回入度为0的节点集合

title: Minimum Numbers of Function Calls to Make Target Array
key_insight: 加1操作对应二进制中1的个数，乘2操作对应最高位数
approach: 总操作=所有数的二进制1的个数之和+最大数的位数-1(共享的乘2操作)

title: Detect Cycles in 2D Grid
key_insight: 在网格中找相同字符组成的环，DFS时不走回头路即可检测
approach: DFS遍历相同字符的连通区域，如果访问到已访问且非父节点则有环

title: Most Visited Sector in a Circular Track
key_insight: 只有起点和终点决定结果，中间的完整圈不影响最多访问扇区
approach: 如果start<=end返回[start,end]，否则返回[1,end]+[start,n]
